solutions.q: What artificial intelligence solutions does KopTup offer?
solutions.a: Our main product is RAG systems: AI that answers from your company documents and cites the source. We also implement chatbots for WhatsApp and web, process automation, predictive analytics, intelligent document processing, expert systems and AI content generation.

cost.q: How much does it cost to implement artificial intelligence in my company?
cost.a: It depends on the solution and the scope. RAG systems have published prices: a {pilotWeeks}-week pilot for {pilotPrice} and the Essential plan with a {essentialSetup} implementation plus {essentialMonthly} per month, plus VAT where applicable. Other solutions are quoted for your case; you'll find reference prices on the services page.

howTo.q: How do I implement artificial intelligence in my business in Colombia?
howTo.a: This is how we do it at KopTup: 1) we review your processes and documents to find where AI adds value; 2) we choose the right technology for your case; 3) we run a pilot with your data (for a RAG system, with your documents in {pilotWeeks} weeks); 4) we integrate it with your systems and train your team; 5) we provide support and continuous improvement.

whoBenefits.q: Which companies in Colombia can benefit from artificial intelligence?
whoBenefits.a: Those that handle a lot of information in documents or repeat the same tasks and inquiries every day. For example: healthcare (clinical protocols, industry regulations and medical claims auditing), legal (contracts, internal legal opinions and regulations) and support or customer service (manuals, policies and knowledge base), as well as retail, logistics, education and finance.
